evals.prompt: Create a PR description for my current branch against origin/main. The diff adds a feature-flagged model selector to Copilot and includes backend tests. Keep it concise and mention risks.
evals.expected_output: A concise PR draft using Summary, What changed, Why, and Notes, with no generic AI wording and no unnecessary validation section unless commands are known.

evals.prompt: write a pull request body for this bugfix: users can pick a model mode in the UI, but async defaults were overwriting it before submit. I ran eslint and typecheck.
evals.expected_output: A short bugfix PR description using Problem, Why this approach, Technical changes, and Risks / edge cases, plus compact validation because commands are known.

evals.prompt: draft a GitHub PR description from this summary only: add supplier export CSV, new endpoint, frontend button, no tests yet. make it not sound AI generated.
evals.expected_output: A very concise PR draft that sticks to the provided summary, mentions no tests were run, and avoids invented context.
